name: Worn Stone Token
summary: Across the Alterac Mountains, Worn Stone Token enchantments have faded, though Dalaran crafted them to command elementals. The tokens remain with Dalaran personnel, from mages to laborers.

sections.title: Tokens of Elemental Mastery
sections.body: Dalaran’s magi command elementals with talismans that bend beings from other realms to their will. Worn Stone Tokens are depleted versions of these implements. Theurgists and summoners carry them, as do Dalaran laborers and guards stationed around the ruins and internment camps of Alterac. Their presence shows how deeply elemental binding reaches into Dalaran’s daily work.

sections.title: Forsaken Curiosity
sections.body: At Tarren Mill, the Forsaken watch the nearby wizards. Magus Voidglare seeks Worn Stone Tokens to study Dalaran’s methods of enslaving elementals. Keeper Bel'varil directs agents to gather worn, inert tokens first. These let the Magus examine basic enchanting techniques safely before attempting more potent, volatile conduits.

faq.q: What were these tokens used for?
faq.answer: Dalaran’s wizards use the stone tokens to bind and command elementals summoned from other realms, setting them to work as laborers, guards, and defenders.

faq.q: Why are the tokens described as worn?
faq.answer: The tokens’ active enchantments have faded with time and heavy use. Keeper Bel'varil considers inert specimens safer for Magus Voidglare’s first study of Dalaran’s binding rituals.
Dalaran personnel in the southern Alterac Mountains carry them, from high-ranking summoners and theurgists to ordinary laborers, shield guards, and Warden Belamoore at the internment camp.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken want them?
faq.answer: Magus Voidglare wants to study Dalaran’s arcane control of elementals and unravel its arts of summoning and subjugation.

angles.text: As a mage, you recognize these tokens as practical focuses the Kirin Tor uses to keep conjured elementals stable and obedient in the field.
As a member of the Horde, you can help the Forsaken at Tarren Mill study the arcane defenses and practices of the hostile Kirin Tor presence in Alterac.
